overall_summary: Data volume is extremely small with low view counts (1-20 views) and zero engagement across all videos. Patterns are indicative rather than definitive; controlled exploration with relatable daily digital-life situations is recommended.

winning_patterns.pattern: Specific digital/phone relational hooks (saved numbers, old chats)
winning_patterns.evidence: Top performing videos 'पुराना नंबर और अधूरा रिश्ता' (20 views) and 'Dil Ki Diary: Bewafai...' (17 views) both focused on saved photos or contact names.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on tangible digital triggers like unsent drafts, voice notes, or archived chats.

weak_patterns.pattern: Direct preachy tone on abstract themes without micro-moments
weak_patterns.evidence: 'Self Respect Story' received only 1 view, significantly lagging behind story-driven hooks.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract thematic statements; convey topics like self-respect strictly through subtle actions.

next_video.hook_style: Visual action hook centered around everyday technology
next_video.concept: A person types a long heart-felt message in a chat draft, hesitates, and deletes it letter by letter.
next_video.opening_direction: Show a late-night phone screen typing 'क्या तुम्हें मेरी याद आती है?' inside a quiet chat box.
next_video.twist_direction: Instead of sending it, they delete the whole text and just type 'Happy Birthday', realizing some words are better left unsaid.
next_video.reason: Early morning uploads (07:00-08:00 UTC / 12:30-01:30 PM IST) yielded the highest comparative views (20 views) in early data.

experiment: Testing if visual typing/deleting actions in chat screens drive higher watch time compared to voice-only intros.
